title: Courts and Tribunals Bill
summary: A Bill to Make provision in relation to criminal courts in England and Wales; to make provision about the leadership of tribunals; to amend section 1 of the Children Act 1989 to remove the presumption relating to the involvement of parents in the life of a child; and for connected purposes.

title: Representation of the People Bill
summary: Make provision extending the right to vote to 16 and 17 year olds; to make provision about the registration of voters; to make provision about the administration and conduct of elections, referendums and recall petitions; to make provision about election agents’ addresses; to make provision about political expenditure and political donations; to make provision about information to be included in electronic campaigning material; to make provision about offences and civil sanctions in connection with elections, referendums and recall petitions and with donations and expenditure for political purposes; to repeal provision about the designation of a strategy and policy statement for the Electoral Commission; to make provision about the disclosure of information by the Electoral Commission; to make provision about the disqualification of offenders for holding elective offices, and their sentencing, where offences are aggravated by hostility towards persons involved in elections, referendums or recall petitions or holders of such offices; and for connected purposes.

title: Armed Forces Bill
summary: A Bill to continue the Armed Forces Act 2006; to amend that Act and other enactments relating to the armed forces; to make provision about the reserve forces; to make provision about visiting forces; to make provision about the Ministry of Defence Police; to make provision about the defence functions of the Oil and Pipelines Agency; to make provision about the protection of military remains; and for connected purposes.

title: Cyber Security and Resilience (Network and Information Systems) Bill
summary: A Bill to Make provision, including provision amending the Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018, about the security and resilience of network and information systems used or relied on in connection with the carrying on of essential activities.

title: Artificial Superintelligence Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision to prohibit the development, deployment and operation of artificial superintelligence systems; to establish monitoring and control powers in respect of such systems; and for connected purposes.

title: Regulated Professions (Freedom of Speech) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to protect the freedom of expression of professionally regulated individuals; to impose duties of neutrality on professional regulatory bodies; and to restrict the imposition by such bodies of mandatory training or education of a political, ideological, or social nature.

title: Financial Services and Markets Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to make provision about the regulation of financial services and markets; and for connected purposes.

title: Building Safety (Remediation of Unsafe Cladding etc) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about fire safety in buildings containing multiple dwellings, including provision for the assessment and remediation of external walls that give rise to risks from fire, and the mitigation of such risks, in taller buildings; to make provision for the obtaining and recording of information about buildings containing residential accommodation; to make provision about liabilities in connection with unsafe construction products; and to make other provision in connection with the safety and management of residential buildings.

title: Civil Aviation Authority (Ombudsman) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision for the appointment and functions of an ombudsman to investigate regulatory decisions made by the Civil Aviation Authority; and for connected purposes.

title: Multi-Storey Car Parks (Safety) Bill
summary: A Bill to increase the minimum required height of guarding in multi-storey car parks; to make provision about the height of guarding in existing multi-storey car parks; to require 24-hour staffing of multi-storey car parks; and for connected purposes.

title: Domestic Abuse (Pets etc) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about protection for pets and other domestic animals within domestic abuse proceedings, including through non-molestation orders and occupation orders; to amend the definitions of controlling or coercive behaviour and economic abuse to include abuse involving pets and domestic animals; to extend the application of Domestic Abuse Protection Orders to cover pets and domestic animals; and for connected purposes.

title: Fur (Import and Sale) Bill
summary: A Bill to prohibit the import and sale of fur; and for connected purposes.

title: Funeral Directors etc (Register) Bill
summary: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to prepare and maintain a register of funeral directors, private mortuaries, direct cremation services and certain other persons who transport or hold the bodies of deceased persons; and for connected purposes.

title: Finance Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision in connection with finance.

title: Barbers and Hairdressers (Registration) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision for the compulsory registration of barbers and hairdressers in England.

title: Powers of Attorney Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about lasting powers of attorney; and for connected purposes.

title: Railways Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about railways and railway services; and for connected purposes.

title: Health Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about health and social care.

title: Visitor Levy (England) Bill
summary: A Bill to Make provision for and in connection with the imposition, by strategic authorities, of a new local tax in respect of stays in residential accommodation.

title: Hospice Funding Bill
summary: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to publish proposals relating to the funding by integrated care boards of medicines and pharmacy services for patients in hospices; and for connected purposes.

title: Strategic Litigation Against Public Participation (No. 2) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about the use of litigation to suppress freedom of speech.

title: Commissioner for Poverty Prevention (Establishment) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to establish an independent Commissioner for Poverty Prevention.

title: Church Appointments (Repeal of Discriminatory Provision) Bill
summary: A Bill to Repeal provision which prohibits persons of the Roman Catholic or Jewish faiths from advising the Crown on appointments in the Church of England or Church of Scotland; and to repeal provision which precludes such persons from making ecclesiastical appointments.

title: Social Housing Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to make provision about social housing.

title: Armed Forces Compensation Scheme and War Pension Scheme (Report) Bill
summary: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to report to Parliament on the potential merits of disregarding compensation received under the War Pension Scheme and Armed Forces Compensation Scheme for the purpose of calculating entitlement to Pension Credit and to other means-tested benefits for which such payments are not disregarded in full; and for connected purposes.

title: Illegal Trading (Temporary Closure of Premises) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about the temporary closure of premises connected to illegal trading; to make further provision relating to such closures; and for connected purposes.

title: Complications from Abortions (Annual Report) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to publish an annual report on complications from abortions in England; and for connected purposes.

title: European Union (Withdrawal Arrangements) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to make provision to modify the effect on domestic law of arrangements relating to the withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the European Union; and for connected purposes.

title: Personal Data (Digital Twins) Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about the regulation of software or algorithms which use or hold personal data for the purpose of modelling the preferences or behaviours of a person; to make provision about the rights of individuals in respect of the holding and use of their personal data by such software or algorithms; and for connected purposes.

title: Corporate Waste Responsibility Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to require large companies to appoint a named director responsible for compliance with statutory waste duty of care obligations; to make such companies financially responsible for the clean-up and clearance of waste they have generated or controlled where that waste is mismanaged and the duty of care has not been discharged; and for connected purposes.

title: Ceramics (Country of Origin Marking) Bill
summary: A Bill to require the indication of country of origin for ceramic products; and for connected purposes.

title: Highways (Financing) Bill
summary: A Bill to Make provision for licences authorising the charging of tolls in return for securing works on trunk roads in England; about the functions of holders of licences; about enforcement; for a special administration regime for holders of licences; about the collection and enforcement of tolls charged under other Acts; and for connected purposes.

title: Fireworks Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about fireworks; and for connected purposes.

title: Mental Capacity (Duty to Assess) Bill
summary: A Bill to require persons discharging functions on behalf of certain other persons to assess the mental capacity of those persons in specified circumstances; and for connected purposes.

title: Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about commonhold land; to prohibit the grant or assignment of certain new long residential leases of flats; to amend the Leasehold and Freehold Reform Act 2024 in relation to the prohibition of the grant or assignment of certain long residential leases of houses; to make provision about leasehold enfranchisement and the right to extend a long residential lease; to make provision about ground rent; to make provision about administration charges; to make provision about gigabit-capable broadband connections in leasehold premises; to make provision about advice concerning estate management matters; to make provision about remedies in connection with breach of covenants of long residential leases; to make provision about estate rentcharges and similar sums; and for connected purposes.

title: Park Homes Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about park homes.

title: Health and Disability Benefits Reform Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to reform the assessment process for health-related and disability benefits in England and Wales, including the minimum age at which applicants can be assessed and the nature of assessment appointments; and for connected purposes.

title: Mental Health Support (Sentence of Detention and Imprisonment for Public Protection) Bill [HL]
summary: A bill to make provision to ensure the mental health needs of individuals sentenced to detention and imprisonment for public protection are met; and for connected purposes.

title: British Sovereignty Protection (Chagos Islands) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to affirm and protect the sovereignty of the United Kingdom over the Chagos Islands and the British Indian Ocean Territory; to make provision restricting the cession or transfer of sovereignty without the approval of Parliament and without the consent of the Chagossian people; to provide for the protection of the Territory’s strategic and defence importance; and for connected purposes.

title: Creative Education Access Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to make provision for a minimum standard of access to creative and cultural education in state-funded schools in England and Wales; to promote partnerships between schools and the creative sector; and for connected purposes.

title: Youth Justice Board for England and Wales (Restoration of Powers and Responsibilities) Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to restore the powers and responsibilities of the Youth Justice Board for England and Wales; and for connected purposes.

title: Public Office (Accountability) Bill
summary: A Bill to Impose a duty on public authorities and public officials to act with candour, transparency and frankness; to make provision for the enforcement of that duty in their dealings with inquiries and investigations; to require public authorities to promote and take steps to maintain ethical conduct within all parts of the authority; to create an offence in relation to public authorities and public officials who mislead the public; to create further offences in relation to the misconduct of persons who hold public office and to abolish the common law offence of misconduct in public office; to make provision enabling persons to participate at inquiries and investigations where the conduct of public authorities may be in issue; and for connected purposes.

title: Perinatal Mental Health Assessments Bill
summary: A Bill to require the provision of mental health assessments in NHS antenatal care for the purpose of identifying those at risk of perinatal mental health problems and making referrals to appropriate support; and for connected purposes.

title: Future Generations (Policy Impact) Bill
summary: A Bill to require public bodies to have regard to the impacts of policy decisions on future generations and the sustainable development principle; to require the assessment and measurement of the long-term effects of such decisions; to provide for reports to Parliament; and for connected purposes.

title: Immigration and Asylum Bill
summary: A Bill to Make provision about immigration, asylum and modern slavery; and for connected purposes.

title: Sporting Events Bill [HL]
summary: A Bill to make provision for enabling a common set of legislative provisions to be applied to major sporting events held in the United Kingdom; to confer power to provide financial assistance in relation to sporting events held in England, Scotland or Northern Ireland; and for connected purposes.

title: Submarine Recycling Strategy Bill
summary: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to prepare and publish a strategy for recycling decommissioned submarines; and for connected purposes.

title: Safety of Nurseries (CCTV) Bill
summary: A Bill to require the use of closed-circuit television (CCTV) in nurseries; to make provision about the retention, storage, disclosure and review of such CCTV recordings; to make provision about minimum standards and auditing requirements for digital devices used to access CCTV recordings in such settings; and for connected purposes

title: Abattoir Services Etc. Bill
summary: A Bill to make provision about the designation of abattoir services as Critical National Infrastructure; to place a duty on certain persons to ensure the provision of adequate meat production infrastructure, including abattoir services; and for connected purposes.

title: Images (Non-consensual Recording and Distribution) Bill
summary: A Bill to create offences relating to the non-consensual recording of images of a person, and relating to the distribution of any such images with the purpose of obtaining sexual gratification or of causing alarm, humiliation or distress to that person; and for connected purposes.
